_meta.source: TRUAD platform (connect.truad.com/perform), 'Overall Performance' table, screenshots supplied by Jules 2026-09-05
_meta.purpose: Actual media spend by channel by month, used to reconcile the agency fee. The approved budget bills agency fees as 0.20 x (Google + Meta); the GL shows the agency billed the flat BUDGETED fee instead ($2,393.20/mo Jan-Mar, $1,700/mo May-Jul), so the overcharge is the difference between what was billed and 20% of what was actually spent.
_meta.reconciliation_result: Media spend reconciles to the GL within 0.90% for Jan-Jul (TRUAD $68,228.97 vs GL $67,617.83). The agency fee, however, was UNDER-billed by $1,366.79 against the contracted 0.20 x actual media - so the $8,528.87 credit is NOT explained by the fee formula. See reports/restatement_2026-08.md.

platform_revenue_warning: TRUAD 'Platform Revenue' is ad-platform-reported conversion value and is NOT NetSuite NET revenue. Jan-Aug 2026: TRUAD reports $7,092,965.84 on $76,357.42 of media, an implied ROAS of $92.89 per $1. The 2026 cohorts have actually produced $1,031,222.11 of NET revenue to date against $127,397.34 of total marketing spend - a real ROAS of $8.09. TRUAD overstates revenue 6.9x and ROAS about 11x. Its ROAS chart displays values from $36 to $216 per $1. These figures must never appear on a VHPC dashboard, feed any ROAS calculation, or be quoted to leadership.
